description: Inference-only C1 evaluation of the same three frozen perfect-trained posteriors under two deployment channel families.

confidence.data_selection_allowance_source: journal/CAMPAIGN_RESULTS.md: 473 unique completed earlier journal trials; this intentionally overcounts repeated data/prior/model setups.
confidence.note: Union allocation over all declared earlier journal trials accounts conservatively for choosing these checkpoints after prior campaign exploration. Uniformity over the posterior covers algorithm selection within each data/prior/model setup. Three checkpoints are fixed before the fresh empirical MC streams; MC budget is divided only among those three evaluations. Analytic channel shift bounds apply simultaneously to every displayed severity.
confidence.limitation: Conditional on the supplied theorem assumptions and a declared data-setup count covering all considered data/prior/model setups. Held-out test metrics have no claimed population confidence interval.

split_change: Erasure remains at hidden width-eight features. Centered lognormal additive noise is on the two output logits, with the full trained NN as transmitter and softmax as receiver. Perfect-channel training predictor is identical.
smooth_loss_lipschitz_derivation: grad ell=a(p_y)(softmax-e_y)/log(1/epsilon), 0<=a<=1; hence norm<=sqrt(2)/log(1/epsilon) uniformly over weights, data, labels, logits.

lognormal_reference.deployment: Independent known centered standardized lognormal coordinates; N_i=sigma*(exp(tau*Z_i-tau**2/2)-1)/sqrt(expm1(tau**2)), tau=.1

direct_distance_benchmark.status: Independent diagnostic MC only; not a certified first-inequality bound

lognormal_reference.reference_choice: Fixed moment-matched s=sigma, known from the channel law. The full second expression requires no numerical integration or numerical optimization. No deployment-distance MC or test metrics enter the bound.
lognormal_reference.direct_benchmark: Independent2m-sample MC diagnostic with standard error; no simple known closed form for the two-dimensional centered-lognormal mean Euclidean norm. Not a certified first bound.
lognormal_reference.singularity: For sigma>0, KL(P||delta_0)=infinite; P<<Gaussian Q, reference exponential moment and exact KL are finite.

scope: No model training or hyperparameter selection was performed.
The second inequality is a closed-form computable relaxation; direct deployment mean distance is shown only as an independent MC diagnostic.
Held-out risks and accuracies are finite-test Gibbs MC estimates. SD bars describe three initialization seeds, not rigorous test-population confidence intervals.
Each per-seed risk upper concerns smooth bounded Gibbs loss, includes a fresh empirical MC correction, and is conditional on the supplied C1/data theorem assumptions.
Means of per-seed bounds bound the mean risk of the uniform mixture over these posteriors on the simultaneous event; they do not bound each seed by that mean.
Uncapped bounds above one are vacuous; no claim of a numerical classification-error or raw-CE certificate is made.
The additive-output Lipschitz argument does not establish a uniform Euclidean K for the existing hidden feature Gaussian channel.
